attestation_ref.description: Legacy pointer to a verifier result used during issuance. Prefer attestation_verification for the authoritative decision context; when both are present, attestation_ref.digest should mirror attestation_verification.attestation_receipt_digest.

attestation_verification.description: Summary of how attestation evidence affected this authoritative action receipt without making the verifier receipt itself the authority object. For decisive consuming outcomes (`accepted`, `degraded`, `rejected`), pin the exact requirement/receipt/policy digest tuple instead of relying on backend policy-service folklore. `degraded` means the consumed attestation.requirement already allowed degraded posture; v0 has no hidden degraded-waiver lane. `rejected` never silently mints an ordinary workload identity; explicit emergency crossing belongs in breakglass, not an issue receipt. Decisive summaries also carry `attestation_receipt_verdict` so the consuming receipt mirrors the exact verdict already present in the pinned `attestation.receipt` rather than reinterpreting it in service-side state. If breakglass preceded a later ordinary lane, the pinned attestation receipt for that ordinary lane must be fresh and issued after the relevant breakglass receipt `created_at`; breakglass does not silently reopen ordinary authority. Post-breakglass resumption is time-ordered too: the pinned `attestation.receipt.created_at` must be strictly later than the relevant breakglass receipt `created_at`, and workload-identity-issue-receipt.issued_at and `captured_at` must not predate the pinned `attestation.receipt.created_at`. If breakglass materially gated or explained this ordinary authority decision, carry `relevant_breakglass_receipt_digest` so detached tooling can find the exact breakglass receipt whose `created_at` formed the resumption barrier instead of rediscovering “the relevant breakglass” from backend state or latest-session folklore. That joined breakglass receipt must describe the same host as the pinned `attestation.receipt.subject.host_id`; do not treat `relevant_breakglass_receipt_digest` as cross-host emergency context or backend-reconstructed freshness.

decision.description: Summary result actually consumed by this authority decision. `attestation_receipt_verdict` must mirror the exact verdict in the pinned attestation receipt; do not reinterpret that verdict in service-side state. `degraded` means the consumed attestation.requirement already allowed degraded posture; v0 has no hidden degraded-waiver lane. `rejected` never silently mints an ordinary workload identity; explicit emergency crossing belongs in breakglass. If breakglass preceded a later ordinary lane, any resumed ordinary authority must consume a fresh attestation receipt issued after the relevant breakglass receipt `created_at` instead of reusing pre-breakglass evidence. The pinned `attestation.receipt.created_at` must be strictly later than that breakglass receipt `created_at`, and workload-identity-issue-receipt.issued_at and `captured_at` must not predate the pinned `attestation.receipt.created_at`. When breakglass materially mattered, also carry `relevant_breakglass_receipt_digest`; do not infer the governing emergency session from host history, latest-wins resolver behavior, or backend-reconstructed freshness.

attestation_requirement_digest.description: Exact digest/id of the attestation.requirement actually consumed by this authority decision.

attestation_receipt_digest.description: Exact digest/id of the attestation.receipt actually consumed by this authority decision.

attestation_receipt_verdict.description: Exact verdict from the pinned attestation.receipt. Keep the consuming summary mirror-shaped (`accepted`→`pass`, `degraded`→`degraded`, `rejected`→`fail`) instead of reinterpreting the same receipt in service-side state.

attestation_admission_policy_digest.description: Exact digest/id of the attestation.admission.policy that materially gated this authority decision; do not recover it later from policy-service/database state.

relevant_breakglass_receipt_digest.description: Exact digest/id of the `breakglass.receipt` whose `created_at` formed the post-breakglass ordinary-resumption barrier for this authority decision. Carry it whenever breakglass materially gated or explained this ordinary lane; the joined `breakglass.receipt.session.host_id` must match the pinned `attestation.receipt.subject.host_id`. Do not recover the relevant breakglass session later from dashboards, host history, latest-wins folklore, cross-host inventory joins, or backend-reconstructed freshness.
